title: TETHER reusable data-source requirements
scope: Public requirements template for an unconfigured deployment. No datasets, local acquisition histories, parsing results, verification records or artifact permissions are supplied. Source-specific eligibility and scientific validation must be established for each new use.
null_policy: null means unknown or unselected, never zero or absence of scientific evidence. Dataset dates and sizes need exact artifact evidence; minimum fields are normalized-output requirements, not verified raw schemas.

forbids: Restricted products in default public route
historical_benchmark.note: Origin/model/horizon not selected by this scaffold.

contemporary_assessment.note: Cannot be relabeled a historical benchmark.

virtual_biotech_reproduction.note: Reference reproduction profile only. Its 38-directory inventory does not prove historical compatibility or payload completeness.

includes: Labels, gold answers, splits, expert ratings, canaries, future outcomes and comparator answer keys
evaluation_only.note: Future agent manifests exclude these assets. Directory separation and gitignore are not a security boundary.

task_definitions.T1: Next clinical transition within a registered horizon

hypothesis_definitions.H5: Dossier quality, correctness, cost and expert preference

ablation_definitions.A2: Remove outcome-trained scorer; LLM states probability

providers.name: HGNC
notes: Monthly gene nomenclature archives; withdrawal and alias history need version pins.

providers.name: Ensembl
notes: Human release-specific gene annotations and protein/gene mappings.

providers.name: GENCODE
notes: Human gene definitions; distinguish comprehensive and protein-coding/MANE selections.

providers.name: NCBI Gene, dbSNP and reference assemblies
notes: Select the relevant Gene, dbSNP or assembly product; do not infer one license/access policy across all NCBI resources.

providers.name: UniProt
notes: Entry/sequence/annotation versions are distinct. Live lookup alone is insufficient for historical reconstruction.

providers.name: Experimental Factor Ontology
notes: Release-specific disease mappings.

providers.name: Mondo Disease Ontology
notes: Release-specific disease equivalence and hierarchy.

providers.name: MeSH
notes: Annual MeSH versions and term mappings.

providers.name: Human Phenotype Ontology
notes: Gene/phenotype and organ-context vocabulary; diagnosis data are not required.

providers.name: UCSC Genome Browser
notes: Liftover chains are build-specific; validate remapping rather than mixing coordinates.

providers.name: Open Targets
notes: Platform and legacy Genetics archives have distinct layouts. Integrated-source overlap must be recorded.

providers.name: AACT / CTTI
notes: Historical snapshot restoration and schema compatibility remain unverified.

providers.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
notes: Current API v2 works; do not assume a stable historical-version API.

providers.name: ChEMBL
notes: Direct ChEMBL products carry CC BY-SA 3.0; versions differ in fields and coverage.

providers.name: The Virtual Biotech
notes: Reference commit 71f9da68c95c5ee0ef4c1d9b8f45f10693de022d. Repository code license does not automatically settle rights in all upstream datasets.

providers.name: CTO / CTOD
notes: Paper states MIT dataset terms. Historical weak labels need separate event-date and mapping adjudication.

providers.name: Trial sponsors' official disclosures
notes: Use the actual issuer's dated primary document per program; no generic sponsor news API is assumed.

providers.name: UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project
notes: Controlled-access designation; bucket-listing results do not establish permissions for individual files.

providers.name: deCODE genetics
notes: Select assay/cohort/release and verify file-level terms and regional completeness.

providers.name: eQTL Catalogue
notes: Launched January 2020. Dataset IDs may persist across changed sample sets. Pin release metadata and hashes.

providers.name: GTEx
notes: Separate public summaries/expression from controlled donor data and requester-pays complete associations.

providers.name: INTERVAL plasma pQTL study
notes: 2018 candidate for historical pQTL coverage; full statistics, availability dates and terms are not validated.

providers.name: FinnGen
notes: Public release dates differ from consortium dates; summary access form and actual download must be verified.

providers.name: Pan-UK Biobank
notes: Indexed phenotype summary files; account for overlap with UKB-PPP.

providers.name: GWAS Catalog
notes: Full summary-statistics API is deprecated; file/study selection and ingestion dates matter.

providers.name: IEU OpenGWAS
notes: Most endpoints require JWT; allowances and live-state limitations make this optional.

providers.name: IGSR / 1000 Genomes
notes: Select genome build, ancestry and unrelated reference samples; do not default to mixed panels.

providers.name: Study-specific LD providers
notes: An LD matrix is acquired only for a selected study with documented release, ancestry and variant order.

providers.name: ClinVar
notes: Monthly archived releases differ from latest submissions; preserve review/conflict status.

providers.name: Gene2Phenotype
notes: Functional mechanism and disease definitions are versioned scientific annotations.

providers.name: Orphanet
notes: Separate gene/disease product terms and versions; do not assume all portal contents are interchangeable.

providers.name: International Mouse Phenotyping Consortium
notes: Mouse phenotypes require species, genotype, sex and assay context.

providers.name: gnomAD
notes: Constraint summaries and variant-level data have different sizes and version/build compatibility.

providers.name: Genebass
notes: Burden effects and SKAT/SKAT-O significance are distinct; summary data do not provide clinical event incidence.

providers.name: AstraZeneca PheWAS
notes: Browsable results do not prove a downloadable or redistributable full release.

providers.name: DepMap
notes: Release-specific cancer cell-line screens; actual assay context matters.

providers.name: Tahoe-100M
notes: Pin dataset revision and prepared-pseudobulk recipe; do not treat drug perturbation as a clean gene intervention.

providers.name: BioGRID
notes: ORCS screens and protein interactions are distinct products; source publications require attribution.

providers.name: Replogle genome-scale Perturb-seq
notes: K562 and RPE1 have different cellular contexts; RPE1 is immortalized, not primary tissue.

providers.name: CRISPRbrain
notes: Differentiated-cell screens; verify individual screen downloads and terms.

providers.name: LINCS / CMap
notes: GEO series and correction history must be pinned; genetic subset is not independent of parent releases.

providers.name: CZ CELLxGENE
notes: Pin dated LTS builds and individual dataset licenses; stable/latest aliases move.

providers.name: Tabula Sapiens
notes: Select organ/donor subsets and retain technical/biological replicate metadata.

providers.name: Human Protein Atlas
notes: Versioned RNA/protein/topology data; third-party terms may also apply.

providers.name: NCI Proteomic Data Commons / CPTAC
notes: Separate processed abundance matrices from large mass-spectrometry raw files.

providers.name: Published surfaceome atlases
notes: Select original published supplemental matrices with explicit identifiers, methods, versions and reuse terms.

providers.name: Gene Expression Omnibus
notes: Select accession, file revision, disease, tissue and study-specific terms; no arbitrary collection of all GEO data.

providers.name: Human Tumor Atlas Network
notes: Open processed products and dbGaP-controlled sequencing are separate acquisition units.

providers.name: Reactome
notes: Archive pathway membership and avoid double-counting Open Targets' integrated annotations.

providers.name: Gene Ontology
notes: Ontology and gene annotation releases are distinct products; preserve evidence codes.

providers.name: STRING
notes: Network edges and evidence channels are distinct; integrated associations are not replicated independent evidence.

providers.name: NCI Genomic Data Commons / TCGA
notes: Open processed data and controlled sequencing products are separate; raw patient sequencing excluded by default.

providers.name: cBioPortal
notes: Pin study export and processing version; avoid duplicating the same TCGA study through GDC.

providers.name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database
notes: Pin sequence/model release and confidence. Predicted pocket geometry is not potency.

providers.name: Protein Data Bank / RCSB
notes: Pin structure revision, chain/isoform, ligand and experimental context.

providers.name: CysDB
notes: Prefer original experimental supplemental products; integrated databases may bring additional terms.

providers.name: PROTAC-DB
notes: Restricted optional source; published agreement restricts raw and derived data sharing.

providers.name: Europe PMC
notes: Metadata, abstracts and licensed full-text versions have different temporal/reuse requirements.

providers.name: PubMed / NLM
notes: Annual baseline and update files need ordered version handling; abstract rights are not assumed public domain.

providers.name: bioRxiv / medRxiv
notes: Versioned preprints with per-article licenses; old text is not replaced by the current version.

providers.name: Crossref
notes: Record update/retraction timestamps and license links, not just the original article date.

providers.name: US FDA / openFDA
notes: FAERS/AEMS, structured labels, regulatory documents and openFDA derived fields require separate provenance.

providers.name: DailyMed / NLM
notes: Version SPL content and effective/public dates; a current label is not a historical label.

providers.name: OnSIDES
notes: Data license and embedded terminology obligations are separate checks.

providers.name: SIDER
notes: Access denied during review; terms/downloadability unverified. Not on the default public route.

providers.name: SureChEMBL
notes: Verify current bulk access, publication dates, annotation dates and terms.

providers.name: Google Patents public data
notes: Public tables may incur query charges; use bounded exports and pin table/version.

providers.name: MedDRA
notes: Dictionary/hierarchy and AI use are restricted; coded observations must be assessed separately.

providers.name: UMLS / RxNorm
notes: Public API lookups and complete licensed vocabulary releases are different products; ChEMBL remains the primary molecule mapping.

providers.name: Retrieve to Explain
notes: External outcomes have noncommercial share-alike terms; literature and genetics branches differ temporally.

providers.name: OriGene / TRQA
notes: TRQA subsets differ in origin; commercial-source answers are not assumed cleared for redistribution.

providers.name: Alvessa / GenomeArena
notes: Repository refers to a PDF license not successfully parsed during review; optional reuse remains restricted pending verification.

providers.name: TargetBench / TargetPro
notes: Clinical-target retrieval benchmark; not an independently dated outcome cohort.

providers.name: BiomniBench
notes: Process-rubric benchmark; retain published-study contamination caveats and asset licenses.

providers.name: TxBench-PP
notes: Preclinical pharmacology task assets; exact release and reuse terms remain to be checked.

providers.name: DrugAgent
notes: Binding labels are a separate endpoint; source/model overlap must be audited.

providers.name: Biomni
notes: Record its environment/dataset inventory for an adapted comparator; do not download every advertised database.

providers.name: OMIM
notes: Optional component dependency; access/terms need separate registration checks.

providers.name: MSigDB
notes: Optional pathway component with registration and source-specific terms.

providers.name: DisGeNET
notes: Optional third-party component; do not make licensed data a primary dependency.

providers.name: DrugBank
notes: Optional chemistry/KG dependency; no assumption of a freely redistributable database.

providers.name: TETHER project-generated assets
notes: Future curation, calculations, benchmark records and prediction logs; none is produced by this documentation scaffold.

providers.name: BindingDB
notes: Optional binding comparator input; distinguish its own affinity records from imported ChEMBL/other sources and model training data.
